{{Top|leg}}
A '''sensor pack''' was a rectangular-shaped portable [[Sensor/Legends|scanning unit]] that incorporated a readout display, a scanning dish, and a number of dials and switches.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Sensor packs could be used to detect a variety of information from the surrounding area. This included life forms, energy emissions, tectonic instability,<ref name="RPG2-RE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> comm signals,<ref name="RPG-Core" /> and other natural and artificial phenomena. Most sensor packs were bulky and handheld, and some were large enough to be handled by two people. Smaller sensor packs were limited to detecting only a single phenomenon, such as a communications signal or life form.<ref name="RPG2-RE" />

[[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav Technologies]] manufactured the [[8932/D Sensor Pack]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RPG2-RE" /> Sensor packs could also be found in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] combat vehicles.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
